text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Thursday it expects to take further restructuring charges in future years to rationalize its European manufacturing and to provide for additional consolidation of warehouse facilities in the United States.
It said the financial justification and pay-back of these efforts are expected to be significant. No further details were immediately available.

Federal-Mogul Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Dick Snell said in a statement that the company expects positive cash flow to result from its restructuring and and said the company has put in place a strategy to return Federal-Mogul to high levels of profitability.

"As we look forward, our original equipment customers continue to look for and need system approaches with products," he said in a statement. "We have opportunities to logically expand our manufacturing product offerings in related product lines so that in the future we can be more of a systems provider."
"We anticipate substantial future growth internationally as we follow our original equipment customers to new markets," said Snell.
Federal-Mogul is a $2 billion global manufacturer and distributor of a broad range of parts primarily for automobiles, light trucks, heavy trucks, and farm and construction vehicles.
